column2: Fresh clean Default 7 config; no custom keymap, mouse map, or third-party extensions; audio device closed; transport stopped
Track A MIDI items A1/A2; Track B audio item B1 and MIDI item B2; initial selection A1
Open Action List; move its 701x475 window to x0,y300; search/select exact action description; move real pointer to Audio B1 at 500,225; press Enter. Arrangement remains visible above Action List.
Both Action List keyboard Runs used Audio B1 as GetItemFromPoint() target. 40529 adds B1 to MIDI A1, then 40530 removes B1; Track B becomes last-touched.
